name: Littlestone Dimension / Prefix-$k$ Littlestone Dimension
details: A prefix-$k$ shattered tree is an ordinary shattered Littlestone tree. For every fixed $k\ge2$, half-intervals give an unbounded separation; $k=1$ is the stated equality case.
proof: The prefix-$k$ condition only restricts the coordinate labels allowed in an ordinary Littlestone tree. Therefore $\mathrm L(\mathcal H)\ge\mathrm{PL}_k(\mathcal H)$ for every $k\ge1$; for $k=1$, the condition is vacuous and equality holds.
witness_verification: For every fixed $k\ge2$, the half-interval class has $\mathrm L=\Theta(\log n)$ and $\mathrm{PL}_k=1$. The same value record separately states the exceptional identity $\mathrm{PL}_1=\mathrm L$.
